name: agent-infra
description: Durable infrastructure for an agent working a repo over time. brain is the memory: a git-backed, agent-queryable knowledge substrate (Graphify code graph + Obsidian-style concept wiki + the graph→wiki→raw query rule). wave is the labor: waves of unsupervised workers on vetted tracker issues, a consumer of brain and never a dependency of it.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Standalone knowledge-substrate plugin: the 3-step graph→wiki→raw query rule, /init /save /resume /freshness /tidy /verify /label /consolidate /wiki-ingest /doctor skills, a self-gating graph-before-grep hook, the vault scaffolding + bin scripts, and a multi-vault registry for routing a project to the right brain (personal vs team). Version is intentionally NOT set here — it is resolved from brain/.claude-plugin/plugin.json (single source of truth); bump it there only.

plugins.name: wave
plugins.description: Run waves of unsupervised workers on agent-ready Linear, Jira or ClickUp issues, on Orca or a direct git-worktree runtime, configured per repo (.claude/wave/config.env). A consumer of brain, never a dependency of it. Version lives in wave/.claude-plugin/plugin.json only.
